mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(r.ranking_no) FROM tb_ranking r INNER JOIN tb_feed f ON r.feed_no = f.feed_no WHERE r.ranking_type = #{rankingType} AND f.feed_visible_yn = 'Y' AND f.feed_like_visible_yn = 'Y'

SELECT r.ranking_no, r.ranking_order, r.ranking_like_count, r.ranking_previous_order, r.ranking_updated, f.feed_no, f.feed_title, f.user_no, u.user_nickname, u.user_image_url, ff.feed_file_no, ff.feed_file_path FROM tb_ranking r INNER JOIN tb_feed f ON r.feed_no = f.feed_no INNER JOIN tb_user u ON f.user_no = u.user_no INNER JOIN tb_feed_file ff ON f.feed_no = ff.feed_no AND ff.feed_file_sort_order = 1 WHERE r.ranking_type = #{rankingType} AND f.feed_visible_yn = 'Y' AND f.feed_like_visible_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY r.ranking_order ASC LIMIT #{request.pageSize} OFFSET #{request.startRowNum}

SELECT r.ranking_no, r.ranking_order, r.ranking_like_count, r.ranking_previous_order, r.ranking_updated, f.feed_no, f.feed_title, f.user_no, u.user_nickname, u.user_image_url, ff.feed_file_no, ff.feed_file_path FROM tb_ranking r INNER JOIN tb_feed f ON r.feed_no = f.feed_no INNER JOIN tb_user u ON f.user_no = u.user_no INNER JOIN tb_feed_file ff ON f.feed_no = ff.feed_no AND ff.feed_file_sort_order = 1 WHERE r.ranking_type = #{rankingType} AND f.feed_visible_yn = 'Y' AND f.feed_like_visible_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY r.ranking_order ASC LIMIT 3
SELECT ranking_no, feed_no, ranking_type, ranking_order, ranking_like_count, ranking_previous_order, ranking_updated FROM tb_ranking WHERE ranking_type = #{rankingType}

SELECT f.feed_no, f.feed_created, COUNT(fl.feed_like_no) AS feed_like_count FROM tb_feed f INNER JOIN tb_feed_like fl ON f.feed_no = fl.feed_no INNER JOIN tb_user u ON fl.user_no = u.user_no WHERE f.feed_visible_yn = 'Y' AND f.feed_like_visible_yn = 'Y' AND u.user_status IN ('ACTIVE', 'DORMANT') GROUP BY f.feed_no, f.feed_created ORDER BY feed_like_count DESC, f.feed_created ASC, f.feed_no ASC LIMIT #{rankingTypeLimit}

SELECT f.feed_no, f.feed_created, COUNT(fl.feed_like_no) AS feed_like_count FROM tb_feed f INNER JOIN tb_feed_like fl ON f.feed_no = fl.feed_no INNER JOIN tb_user u ON fl.user_no = u.user_no WHERE f.feed_visible_yn = 'Y' AND f.feed_like_visible_yn = 'Y' AND fl.feed_like_created >= #{startDate} AND u.user_status IN ('ACTIVE', 'DORMANT') GROUP BY f.feed_no, f.feed_created ORDER BY feed_like_count DESC, f.feed_created ASC, f.feed_no ASC LIMIT #{rankingTypeLimit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_ranking ( feed_no, ranking_type, ranking_order, ranking_like_count, ranking_previous_order, ranking_updated ) VALUES ( #{feedNo}, #{rankingType}, #{rankingOrder}, #{rankingLikeCount}, #{rankingPreviousOrder}, #{rankingUpdated} )
